_comment: Default bindings for the GameCube Controller this package declares. The frontend
ships no bindings of its own - a package that declares a controller says how it is
played by default, and the user's own bindings always win.
The face buttons follow the pad's own geometry: A is the big center button and takes
the key under the hand, B sits below-left of it, X to the right, Y on top. Z is the
purple shoulder tab above R. The keyboard arrows drive the MAIN STICK, because that
is how a GameCube game is steered; the d-pad, a secondary control on this pad, takes
IJKL. Triggers are the analog travel; L and R the clicks at the bottom of it.
